# 0=engineer, 1=doctor

for i in range(n):
    s.add(And(name[i] >= 0, name[i] <= 1))
    s.add(And(drink[i] >= 0, drink[i] <= 1))
    s.add(And(occ[i] >= 0, occ[i] <= 1))

s.add(Distinct(drink))
s.add(Distinct(occ))
